Once the I R S discloses your tax return to the third party listed on line 5, the I R S has no control over what the third party does with the information. If you would like to limit the third party's authority to disclose your return information, you can specify this limitation in your written agreement with the third party. Line 6. Tax return requested. Form 1040, 1120, 941, etc. and all attachments as originally submitted to the I R S, including Form(s) W-2, schedules, or amended returns.
